## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (counts, generated docs and the smoke test)
- [ ] If a chart, option or example changed: I ran `npm run docs` and committed the generated files
- [ ] I looked at it in the browser: keyboard (Tab, arrow keys, Escape), empty and one-point data, dark theme, a narrow width, clean console
- [ ] No new dependency, no network request, no real data
- [ ] I added a line to `CHANGELOG.md` under Unreleased
